messages.author: 32c0c0475cd60d82
messages.subject: Missing data
parts:
Hello,

I would like to know if it's possible to show missing data (like with include.miss = TRUE) but without a percentage for them, only the number of missing data.

Thank you !

messages.author: 176185748932f5c0
messages.subject: Re: Missing data
parts:
The "include.miss" argument treat non available values (NA) as a new category. This only applies to categorical variables.
To show only the absolute frequencies but not percentages, use "type=3" in "createTable" function. With this, all categorical variables are shown as absolute frequencies only, and also the NA category.

I hope this solves your problem.

Isaac.

messages.author: 32c0c0475cd60d82
messages.subject: Re: Missing data
parts:
Thanks for your answer, but actually I want to show the percentage for all categorical variables and only the absolute frequencies for the NA category.

Rodolphe

messages.author: e4c3fc328ba9081e
messages.subject: Re: Missing data
parts:
By now, it is not possible to display absolute frequencies for "NA" category while showing percentages for the rest of categories. We will consider to implement this option in future versions.

Isaac.
